notes.title: War Of Castles Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello!
This is the first update for War Of Castles. The specific update content is as follows:
[list]
[*] New Creative Workshop: Now custom maps can be added to the Creative Workshop!
[*] In custom maps, you can search for maps by type.
[*] New Steam Achievements
[*] New Pre-battle Buff Selection
[*] New Building: Statue: Each faction can have up to one statue. Different types of statues will provide special effects to different units.
[*] 5 New Statue-related Playable Levels
[/list]

We are continuously developing future versions! You can check our update roadmap. If you're interested in our game, feel free to purchase it or add it to your wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828429/82bf9d2cd2d46861f4bd5dc84c50b03bf85fa9c6.jpg[/img]
